The code had the same validation logic and receipt-building repeated verbatim across the three status branches (`active`, `lapsed`, `suspended`). I extracted them into private helpers (`_`-prefixed, preserved constants, kept `TIER_FEES` lookups identical):

The main `process_renewal` function now reads as a single linear flow with shared helpers, reducing ~80 lines of duplication to clean calls while keeping every error message, fee calculation, and receipt string byte-for-byte identical to before.
